bear.description: Score 10 points for groups of exactly 3 bears.

rules.note: Only groups of exactly 3 adjacent bears score. Singles, pairs, and groups of 4+ score 0.

elk.description: Score based on contiguous groups forming specific shapes.

rules.note: Elk score based on the size of their contiguous formation.

salmon.description: Score based on run length. A run is a contiguous chain with no branches.

rules.note: Salmon must form runs (chains). Minimum 3 salmon to score. No loops or forks.

hawk.description: Score based on total number of isolated hawks (not adjacent to other hawks).

rules.note: Only hawks that have no adjacent hawks score points.

fox.description: Score based on unique adjacent animal types.

rules.note: Each fox scores points equal to the number of unique OTHER animal types adjacent to it.

habitat_scoring.description: Bonus points for largest contiguous habitat areas.

rules.largest_area_bonus: Player with largest contiguous area of each habitat type gets bonus points.
rules.tie_rule: All tied players receive the bonus.

nature_tokens.description: Leftover nature tokens at game end.
